targets: core/source questions lacking a narrower positive rule
positive_rule: Positive country/source-owner document states target administered to survey respondents; narrower rule wins
tri_state_construction: ELIGIBLE_APPLICABLE only when positive administration is frozen; otherwise ROUTING_UNKNOWN
anti_inference_note: Never infer universal administration from absence of a skip note or from nonmissing incidence.

positive_rule: Respondent uses Internet/social-media tools; source master explicitly makes non-use inapplicable
required_determinant_inputs: Accepted positive Internet/social-media-use determinant; not Q206/Q207 by analogy and not Q217-220 missing code
tri_state_construction: ELIGIBLE_APPLICABLE iff positive use determinant; INAPPLICABLE iff positive non-use determinant; otherwise ROUTING_UNKNOWN
anti_inference_note: Master explicitly states filter; released codebook carries INAP semantics, but code/missing incidence is not a membership oracle.

positive_rule: Respondent slots apply to respondent; spouse/mother/father slots require corresponding person-position presence
required_determinant_inputs: Accepted R14 person-position structure + positive person-position-presence fact
tri_state_construction: Relative slot ELIGIBLE_APPLICABLE only with positive presence; positive absence => INAPPLICABLE; unresolved presence => ROUTING_UNKNOWN
anti_inference_note: Master explicitly says no spouse/father/mother => not applicable.

required_determinant_inputs: Accepted R14 applicability + positive spouse-presence fact
tri_state_construction: Q279 follows RB01; Q280 tri-state by spouse presence
anti_inference_note: Last-job wording changes temporal referent, not eligibility.

positive_rule: Q281 respondent; Q282 spouse; Q283 father-at-respondent-age-14 referent
required_determinant_inputs: Accepted R14 applicability + positive person-position-presence fact
tri_state_construction: Q281 follows RB01; Q282/Q283 tri-state by exact person-position availability
anti_inference_note: Father death by age 14 does not itself exclude: questionnaire instructs last-job fallback.

positive_rule: Exact released codebook says data available in national datasets for these 13 countries
required_determinant_inputs: Accepted country coordinate + released codebook module scope
tri_state_construction: Module parent ELIGIBLE_APPLICABLE in one of 13 exact countries; positive outside-country => NOT_ELIGIBLE; target form subrules still apply
anti_inference_note: Final release codebook expands older master list and states released national-dataset scope.

positive_rule: Exact accepted Q294 form assignment = A
required_determinant_inputs: Positive per-respondent form-assignment fact + master 50/50 design authority
tri_state_construction: A => ELIGIBLE_APPLICABLE; explicit B => NOT_ELIGIBLE; missing/unresolved form => ROUTING_UNKNOWN
anti_inference_note: Q294A and Q294B are distinct released source slots. Never derive A from Q294A response incidence.

positive_rule: Exact accepted Q294 form assignment = B
required_determinant_inputs: Positive per-respondent form-assignment fact + master 50/50 design authority
tri_state_construction: B => ELIGIBLE_APPLICABLE; explicit A => NOT_ELIGIBLE; missing/unresolved form => ROUTING_UNKNOWN
anti_inference_note: No complement construction from Q294A; both branches require explicit form assignment.

targets: released MENA_* module slots including MENA_01..MENA_38, MENA_16B, MENA_37B, MENA_Q259
positive_rule: Released codebook states module applied in these four countries and data available in their national data-files
required_determinant_inputs: Accepted country coordinate + released module scope
tri_state_construction: Module parent ELIGIBLE_APPLICABLE in four exact countries; positive outside-country => NOT_ELIGIBLE; child rules may narrow
anti_inference_note: Do not project future Middle-East survey wording onto this release.

required_determinant_inputs: Exact substantive MENA_25 response event under accepted response semantics
tri_state_construction: Yes => ELIGIBLE_APPLICABLE; No => INAPPLICABLE; DK/refusal/missing/unresolved => ROUTING_UNKNOWN
anti_inference_note: Master/codebook both say If yes; codebook explicitly labels -3 as not borrowed money. Membership still comes from positive MENA_25 fact, not child missingness.

positive_rule: Released codebook states WEE module applied in India only
required_determinant_inputs: Accepted country coordinate + released module scope
tri_state_construction: India module parent => ELIGIBLE_APPLICABLE; positive non-India => NOT_ELIGIBLE; target-specific narrower routing requires separate authority
anti_inference_note: Target-specific -3 dictionaries do not themselves define risk sets.

positive_rule: Released codebook states three versions and exact country assignments
required_determinant_inputs: Accepted country coordinate + accepted target-to-version matrix
tri_state_construction: Country fixes module version; target eligibility requires positive target membership in that version
anti_inference_note: Do not infer version membership per variable from which columns are populated.

scope: Administered H309/H310 within exact gender-module version
required_determinant_inputs: Exact H309 substantive response event + accepted version/target administration
tri_state_construction: Yes => ELIGIBLE_APPLICABLE; No => INAPPLICABLE; unresolved parent => ROUTING_UNKNOWN
anti_inference_note: Codebook explicitly labels H310 If yes.

targets: each source slot under released codebook section Additional questions asked in selected countries
scope: Target-specific country named by source-owner codebook entry
positive_rule: Country equals the positively documented country for that target
required_determinant_inputs: Accepted country coordinate + exact codebook target entry
tri_state_construction: Named country => ELIGIBLE_APPLICABLE unless a narrower positive subgroup rule exists; other exact countries => NOT_ELIGIBLE
anti_inference_note: Country prefix is not authority by itself; the codebook country statement is.

required_determinant_inputs: Exact codebook says Asked to female respondents only + accepted sex coordinate
tri_state_construction: Female => ELIGIBLE_APPLICABLE; explicit nonfemale => NOT_ELIGIBLE; unresolved sex => ROUTING_UNKNOWN
anti_inference_note: Do not infer sex from response incidence.
